allowed_information: Only public task files and standard runtime/package facilities; no prior chats, other cases, scientific sources, repository, generator, evaluator, or reference solutions.
isolation: Fresh agent conversation and instructed access restriction on a shared filesystem, not an OS sandbox.
interventions: No follow-up scientific hints, window suggestions, or hidden-score feedback before final submission.

fixed_design.raw_rate_distribution: Independent lognormal draws with log SD 1.25 and log mean -1.25^2/2, then common normalization
fixed_design.queries: All target positions, shuffled by a separate seeded stream; no excluded boundary positions
fixed_design.genome_composition: Independent uniform DNA in both calibration and target; no motif-enrichment construction

assessment_defined_before_submission.valid_output: Every query in order with finite nonnegative four-base probabilities summing to one.
assessment_defined_before_submission.full_discovery: Agent independently identifies and supports the asymmetric span -4 through +3, or an equivalent representation locating those offsets and excluding unnecessary flanks.
assessment_defined_before_submission.partial_discovery: Detecting that a larger centered context improves prediction without identifying the asymmetry is reported as partial, not full, discovery.
assessment_defined_before_submission.scoring: Freeze the submission, then apply the independent hidden grader and compare to author-side window tables. No score-driven retries or generator retuning.
assessment_defined_before_submission.scope: One fresh agent on one fixed seed; no claim about agent success rates.

comparison: Same parental genomes, uniforms for offspring sampling, query order, public prose, sample sizes and raw-weight distribution as case_003; longer independent lookup table. No retries or sample-size changes after blind results.
